rationale: OE 'ceorl' refers specifically to a free male person (a commoner/churl) in Old English society, contrasted with thegns and other ranks. The attestations from legal texts (L. Eth., L. R.) confirm this is a social/legal designation for an adult male human being, best matching man.n.01 (adult male person) rather than the generic human sense or any subordinate/military sense.
